Yes — this matches what I was after. I added the note "Make this for Sunday dinner," and then searching "Sunday" turned up the pasta bookmark even though that word appears nowhere in the title or description, only in my own note. That's exactly the thing I'd been asking for: my personal notes should be findable the same way the rest of the details are. And it treated "Sunday" case-insensitively like the rest of search, which is right.

Your assumptions are mostly right — one note per bookmark, shown right on it, searched alongside everything else. Since you're asking whether the approach is right, one thing I'd want: when I'm writing a note, I'd like to be able to give it a little formatting — say a couple of bullet points or a bit of bold — and have it show up nicely formatted on the bookmark, not just as one flat run of text. The finding-it-by-search part is exactly right; I'd just want the note itself to be a touch richer than plain text when I'm jotting something down. Can we plan for that?
